concept.en: Contiguous dispatch groups and peak capacity

brief.zh: 按 loads 的顺序运完所有货箱。一班运一段连续的箱子，不能拆箱，最多用 shifts 班。返回能完成运输的最小单班容量。箱重为正整数；空货架返回 0，有货却没有班次时返回 -1。
brief.en: Ship the crates in their given order in loads. Each shift takes a continuous group and no crate can be split. Return the smallest per-shift capacity that ships everything within shifts shifts. Crates weigh positive integers. An empty shelf returns 0. Cargo with zero shifts returns -1.

label.en: Try a capacity on a schedule

label.zh: 达到限额时就另开一班
label.en: Start a new shift when the limit is reached
